module.title: Days 1–10 | Foundation Module
module.description: First ten complete lessons; prepared for admin review before production publishing.

lessons.title: Diagnostic & learning map
lessons.objective: Identify prior knowledge, learning gaps and the key outcomes for the course level.
lessons.core_teaching_content: In School Tuition – 9th, this lesson develops diagnostic & learning map. Teach the concept from simple to more complex examples. Use retrieval questions, worked examples and guided practice before independent work. Ask learners to explain their reasoning, not merely produce an answer.
examples: Worked example: Tutor demonstrates the process and highlights the decision points.
Guided example: Learner completes the middle steps while the tutor provides prompts.
Transfer example: Learner applies the idea to a new context and explains the result.
lessons.practical_activity: Concept-to-application workshop followed by a short practice set.
lessons.guided_practice: Complete two examples together using the sequence: understand → plan → solve → verify.
lessons.independent_practice: Complete 5–8 questions independently and use the self-check criteria before submitting.
questions: What does diagnostic & learning map mean in your own words?
How would you explain the idea to a classmate?
Which step requires the most care?
How can you check your answer?
lessons.assessment_checkpoint: Short formative quiz plus one application problem; target clear reasoning and 75%+ accuracy.
lessons.student_task: Prepare a mini study card: definition/rule, example, common mistake and one self-test question.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Use age/level-appropriate examples, check prerequisite gaps, and give specific feedback on reasoning.
lessons.reflection_completion: Complete: I can now ____. I still find ____ difficult. I will practise ____ tomorrow.
